curation_note: Alpha carbon formed by the 427 nm photo-Petasis coupling is 1 unassigned stereocentre: the reaction is not stereoselective and the SI reports no resolution, so the stored SMILES is the constitution only. Regiochemistry (alkyl on the alpha carbon, not the nitrogen) is pinned by the authors' own IUPAC name and the 1H NMR N-CH methine, not by HRMS, which cannot see it.
